text:
maria_sales: Heads up 10: LunaHealth sent a 350-question CAIQ and asked for mapping + evidence. They want an owner + ETA by EOD Fri. Uploaded to SF: https://sf.redwood.co/opps/LUNA-22 (attachment: luna_caiaq_v2.pdf)

alex_s: I can do the control->feature mapping if security approves. Do they expect full evidence (certs, screenshots) or is control statements + config snippets OK for now?

jess_support: I've put the CAIQ into the support case and pasted our canned answers from the KB. No certs/screenshots attached yet.

patrick_security: Marking for security intake. Priorities: validate encryption at rest, KMS usage, network segmentation, tenancy isolation. Preferred evidence: SOC2/ISO certs, KMS console screenshots, export of config snippets. I can review mappings but full evidence collection won't happen until Tue morning.

alex_s: Plan: I'll draft mappings and flag evidence gaps for Patrick. Target: initial draft by Thu EOD, then iterate.

maria_sales: Customer also flagged data-in-region requirements and asked whether private deployment is available and how pricing changes. @owen_eng who should handle pricing uplift questions?

owen_eng: Sales-ops handles firm pricing numbers. Rough guidance: dedicated capacity + KMS/SSO typically adds ~30% on committed pricing; on-prem is a separate conversation with lead times. I'll confirm exact figures with sales-ops tomorrow.

patrick_security: For the CAIQ intake I need their org id + any custom infra notes. Call out KMS/HSM: if they require HSM-backed keys, we need to note supported KMS integrations and any limitations. @alex_s, add a clear caveat.

alex_s: Adding "Key management & residency" section with supported KMS: AWS KMS, GCP KMS; HSM via partner integrations; include standard caveats and required contractual language.

jess_support: FYI they have an internal pentest next month, so they may accelerate evidence requests.

patrick_security: Creating SEC ticket and intake checklist: 1) Confirm deployment model 2) Provide encrypted-at-rest proof 3) Provide KMS config snippet or cert 4) Network/tenancy statement 5) SOC2/ISO certs if available. Evidence collection may take a few days.

deploy_bot: SEC-1148 created and added to security backlog (priority: P2)

alex_s: I'll start the Confluence mapping draft: https://confluence.redwood.co/pages/Luna-CAIQ-Mapping and paste the draft here for review. Please comment inline.

maria_sales: Thanks. I'll tell the customer we have an owner and expect a draft before EOD Fri. If security can't finish evidence, we'll send partial answers and label open items. :thumbsup:
